SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_teams, COUNT(CASE WHEN STUDY_DELETEDATE IS null THEN 1 END) AS active_teams, COUNT(CASE WHEN STUDY_DELETEDATE IS NOT null THEN 1 END) AS inactive_teams, COUNT(CASE WHEN TRUNC(STUDY_CREATEDATE ,'IW') = TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW') THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS weekly_teams FROM STUDY

mapper.select: SELECT C.STUDY_ID, C.STUDY_TITLE, C.STUDY_LIKE, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDYMEMBER WHERE STUDY_ID = C.STUDY_ID) AS STUDY_MAX, (SELECT B.MEM_NICK FROM STUDYMEMBER A INNER JOIN MEMBER B ON (A.MEM_ID = B.MEM_ID) WHERE A.STUDY_ROLL = 'L' AND A.STUDY_ID = C.STUDY_ID) AS MEM_NICK, C.STUDY_GOLD, C.STUDY_SILVER, C.STUDY_BLONZE FROM STUDYMEMBER A INNER JOIN MEMBER B ON (A.MEM_ID = B.MEM_ID) INNER JOIN STUDY C ON (A.STUDY_ID = C.STUDY_ID) WHERE B.MEM_LOGIN_ID = #{memLoginId} ORDER BY C.STUDY_TITLE
